reception: The answer — not without training — is what the citing literature carries forward. Voice-interface work in ICTD and HCI cites the study chiefly as evidence about what untrained users can operate: 99DOTS and Learn2Earn draw on its findings, a review of mobile-phone data collection in developing countries examines its design lessons, and voice-forum and voice-based literacy systems such as Sangeet Swara mention it when surveying IVR precedents. The engagement is mostly brief, a supporting citation in related-work sections, but consistent: the paper serves as the cautionary datum on touchtone interfaces for first-time users.
